WELCOME TO KILKEA CASTLE
One of Ireland's oldest inhabited castles, Kilkea Castle, is a hidden jewel just one hour from Dublin.
With a history dating back to 1180, Kilkea Castle was once the medieval stronghold of the FitzGerald's, Earls of Kildare.
Our 140 Bedroom Resort, set on 180 acres of landscaped gardens, ancient woodland and a meandering river, boasts several accommodation options to appeal to all tastes. This family-owned and managed estate offers a tranquil spa, a challenging 18-hole championship golf course and a world-class culinary experience.
Explore Our Property
Whatever your occassion, Kilkea Castle offers an unforgettable experience surrounded by history, majesty and comfort.

Accommodation
Kilkea Castle presents guests with three distinct accommodation choices. Following a thoughtful restoration, we proudly welcome you to experience the 12th-century Kilkea Castle, the Castle Courtyard Rooms, and the Lodges at Kilkea Castle
Our Secluded Self Catering Lodges at Kilkea is the perfect retreat for families or a loved ones. We have two and three-bedroom self catering lodges onsite. A Home away from Home with full access to the Resort's 180-acre grounds. Several Castle Courtyard Rooms have private entrances and we a number on inter connecting Castle Courtyard Rooms. You can connect up to four Castle Courtyard Rooms.
We look forward to welcoming you to our 140 Bedroom Resort. Experience all Kilkea has to offer with our array of Activities onsite. To better understand each room category enjoy a virtual tour.
Call: +353 59 9145600
Email: info@kilkeacastle.ie

Kilkea Castle
Guests can book to stay in one of our Castle, Castle Courtyard or Lodge Bedrooms. The Castle is also available to hire exclusively.
Our elegant and spacious

partnerships, family gatherings and corporate events.

Deluxe Castle Bedroom
Luxury Castle Bedroom
Castle Suite

360-degree views of the estate, to the elegant Lady Elizabeth Suite with its

spacious and just decadent enough to be fun. With views of the River Greese,
the Rose Garden, the Courtyard and Golf Course, our Castle is flooded with natural

Allow our Events Team to create a bespoke
itinerary that will enhance your Castle experience and wow your guests. Why not
include Champagne Afternoon Tea in the Drawing Room, a formal Dinner in the
Banquet Hall or just enjoy your own Castle Bar. There are so many Things to Do on the Estate,
allow us to organize a private falconry show or book a round of Golf for you and your guests.
We can also accommodate larger
groups on an exclusive basis as our Castle Courtyard Bedrooms are adjacent to the Castle.

Frequently Asked Questions
Everything you need to know before your stay at Kilkea Castle. From check‑in times and getting here, to dining, the spa, golf and our estate activities explore the answers below. Can't find what you're looking for? Our team is always happy to help.
Your Stay
What is the check in time and check out time at Kilkea Castle?
Check in for Castle and Castle Courtyard rooms begins at 3:00pm with check out at 12:00pm.
Check in for The Lodges at Kilkea Castle starts at 4:00pm while check out is at 11:00am.
What is the cancellation policy at Kilkea Castle?
Reservations at Kilkea Castle can be cancelled up to 72 hours prior to arrival at no charge. Cancellations made within 72 hours of arrival will incur a charge.
Are interconnecting or family rooms available?
Yes, there are a number of interconnecting rooms at Kilkea Castle. Please contact the reservations team on +353 59 9145600 if you would like to book an interconnecting room.
Are cots or extra beds available for children?
Yes, we can offer cots or extra beds for children upon request. Pre booking is essential. Please contact reservations prior to your arrival on +353 59 9145600 to ensure availability.
Getting Here & Parking
How far is Dublin City Centre & Dublin Airport from Kilkea Castle?
Kilkea Castle is located in County Kildare, approximately one hour by car from Dublin Airport and Dublin City Centre, making it an easily accessible castle hotel near Dublin while offering a peaceful countryside setting.
Does Kilkea Castle provide transport to and from Dublin Airport?
Yes, Kilkea Castle can arrange private transport to and from Dublin Airport upon request. Guests are advised to contact the hotel in advance to organise airport transfers and confirm availability.
Is there parking available at Kilkea Castle?
Yes, Kilkea Castle offers ample free on‑site parking for guests and visitors. Parking is available at the front of the Castle opposite the Baronial Hall, near The Spa, Castle Courtyard Rooms, and at the Kilkea Castle Golf Club.
Are there electric vehicle charging stations at Kilkea Castle?
Yes, we have two electric car charging stations onsite at Kilkea Castle.
Facilities & Accessibility
Is Wi‑Fi available throughout the castle and rooms?
Yes, complimentary high‑speed Wi‑Fi is available throughout Kilkea Castle, including all guest bedrooms, public areas, bars, restaurants, and meeting spaces.
Does Kilkea Castle have lift or elevator access?
Yes, there is a lift available within Kilkea Castle, providing improved accessibility to selected guest bedrooms and public areas within the historic castle building.
Does Kilkea Castle have accessible bedrooms and bathrooms?
Yes, we have accessible bedrooms and bathrooms at Kilkea Castle. Please contact the reservations team on +353 59 9145600 if you would like to book an accessible room.
Is there a swimming pool at Kilkea Castle?
No, there is not a swimming pool at Kilkea Castle. There is a hydro pool in the Thermal Suite at The Spa.
Dining
What are the dining options at Kilkea Castle?
Kilkea Castle offers a variety of dining experiences, open daily for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and drinks.
Restaurant 1180 provides fine dining within the castle.
Hermione's Restaurant and The Bistro, located at the Clubhouse, offer a more casual yet sophisticated dining experience.
Afternoon Tea is served in the Castle Drawing Room every Saturday and Sunday.
Does Kilkea Castle cater for vegetarian and vegan diets?
Yes, Kilkea Castle caters for vegetarian, vegan, and other dietary requirements. Guests are advised to inform their server or the team in advance so menus can be tailored accordingly.
Can non-residents walk the grounds and dine in the restaurants at Kilkea Castle?
Yes, non‑residents are welcome to explore the grounds of Kilkea Castle and dine in its restaurants. Advance booking is recommended, particularly for dining and Afternoon Tea, to avoid disappointment.
Spa, Golf & Activities
Is there a spa at Kilkea Castle?
Yes, Kilkea Castle is home to an award‑winning boutique spa in County Kildare, featuring a Thermal Suite with steam rooms, sauna cabins, and hydro experiences. The spa includes five treatment rooms, including a couples' suite offering massages, facials, and bespoke body treatments.
What activities and experiences are available at Kilkea Castle?
Our on-site activity centre has four thrilling experiences: Two Dueling Dungeons, Knights Round Table, Shackleton's Quest, and The Hideout which features classic games such as Pac-Man, Pool and Air Hockey. Classic castle pursuits such as Archery and the Air Rifle Experience also take place in the Activity Centre.
There are a number of outdoor experiences available at Kilkea Castle such as Falconry, Fly Fishing, Tennis, Garden Games and The Irish Wolfhound Experience. Pre‑booking is essential.
Can I play a round of golf at Kilkea Castle?
Yes, Kilkea Castle has an 18-hole par 70 championship parkland golf course, measuring 6200 metres. We welcome new members, groups, golf societies, and corporate golf offers. Please contact the Pro Shop on +353 59 914 5600 to make a golf booking.
Is Kilkea Castle dog friendly?
Yes, Kilkea Castle is a dog‑friendly hotel in Ireland, with selected dog‑friendly lodges available on the estate. Dogs are accommodated in designated areas only, and pre‑booking is essential.
Ryder Cup 2027
How far is Kilkea Castle from Dublin Airport and the Ryder Cup venue?
Kilkea Castle is less than one hour from Dublin Airport, providing easy access for international travellers. It is also approximately 100 miles (160 km) from Adare Manor, the Ryder Cup 2027 venue, which is typically under a two-hour drive.

wikipedia.title: Kilkea Castle
wikipedia.extract: Kilkea Castle is located 5 km (3.1 mi) northwest of Castledermot, County Kildare, Ireland near the village of Kilkea on the R418 regional road from Athy to Tullow. It was a medieval stronghold, for over 700 years, of the Fitzgeralds, earls of Kildare.
